testPolicy.value: Fully test-optional for undergraduate admission; no preference is given based on whether scores are submitted, and applicants without scores remain eligible for admission, scholarships and honors consideration.

englishPolicy.value: SMU requires official English-proficiency scores for first-year applicants whose language of instruction is bilingual or not solely English, with some waiver cases. The official international checklist confirms SMU accepts TOEFL, IELTS, and Duolingo; the undergraduate process page identifies the same submission requirement but does not publish a universal minimum score there.
